item.title: House bill seeks higher VA loan fees to fund veterans’ benefits
item.description: Mortgage trade groups are closely monitoring a bill in the U.S. House of Representatives that would raise fees on Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) mortgages to help fund other veterans' benefits.

item.title: Lawmakers move to restrict private listings in Washington
item.description: Washington lawmakers propose a bill to restrict private real estate listings, aiming to boost transparency and public access.

item.title: Engel & Völkers gains top California team from Sotheby’s
item.description: Engel & Völkers welcomes Truszkowski Freedman & Associates, a $1B luxury team formerly brokered with Sotheby's with $45.13M in 2024 sales.

item.title: Max Stokes splits from Fox & Stokes to launch N.J. Compass team
item.description: Stokes is launching a new specialist team under his own name while remaining at Compass, moving away from the mega-team model.

item.title: Top Houston agent leaves Compass for Douglas Elliman
item.description: With $100 million in closed sales in 2025, Dana Johnson is a top-10 agent in Houston and is taking her talents to Douglas Elliman.

item.title: Luxury Presence raises $37M to push CRM platform development
item.description: Luxury Presence’s new artificial intelligence–driven Presence CRM platform is scheduled to roll out in February.

item.title: NAMB urges FHA to end lifetime mortgage insurance rule
item.description: NAMB urges FHA to end its lifetime mortgage insurance rule, citing outdated policies and improved financial conditions for the MMI Fund.

item.title: Cost of retirement comfort soars, leaving most far short
item.description: Survey insights point to a widening gap between what retirees believe is required to retire comfortably and what most actually have.

item.title: Lower mortgage rates support steady new home sales
item.description: The long-delayed report shows new home sales reached 737,000 in October 2025, up 18.7% from last year, as mortgage rates fall near 6%
